collection.description: A friend has talked about almost nothing but knots for days: change the subject kindly, or ask a question.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) has discovered net making and has talked about almost nothing else for days. Knots. Tension. The right kind of fiber. The difference between a square knot and a sheet knot. (subject) has heard everything there is to hear about knots, twice. (subject.He/She) loves (friend). (subject.He/She) does not love knots.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "I'm really glad you've found something you love," says (subject). "Can we talk about something else for a bit? My head is full of knots." (friend) laughs. "Sorry! I get carried away." They talk about other things for the whole walk. Right at the end, (friend) mentions a knot, very quietly. (subject) lets that one go.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) decides to ask one real question. "What's your favorite knot?" (friend) lights up and shows (subject.him/her), and it turns out there's a knot that ties itself if you shake it the right way. That one, (subject) admits, is actually quite good. (subject.He/She) practices it all evening, to (subject.his/her) great annoyance.
